title: Camp Boff
wikitext:
[[File:Camp Boff.jpg|thumb|300px|Camp Boff]]

'''Camp Boff''' is, together with [[Camp Cagg]], [[Camp Kosh|Kosh]], and [[Camp Wurg|Wurg]], the home of some of the [[Dustbelcher]] [[ogre]]s. It is the southeastern camp, only guarded by three Dustbelcher ogres.  One exception though was their leader, [[Boss Tho'grun]], who patrolled the [[Badlands]] between the four ogre bases.
